title: Your First Weekend at Art Center College of Design, Shared as Cards
description: A curated sequence for new students to navigate ArtCenter's dual-campus layout and creative culture during their first weekend in Pasadena.

cards.title: Kick Off with Campus Connect
cards.subtitle: South Campus Orientation Hub
cards.notes: Start your weekend at the South Campus for the 'Campus Connect' event. Meet your cohort and hear the President's welcome address in the 1111 Building.
cards.short_summary: The official in-person orientation kickoff for new students at the South Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: On Sept. 4, the focus shifts to in-person interactions with 'Campus Connect' at 10:00 a.m. on South Campus.
cards.source_title: ArtCenter College of Design to Welcome New Students With Comprehensive Orientation
cards.access_notes: Mandatory for new students; check your Inside ArtCenter portal for specific room assignments.

cards.title: Master the Campus Shuttle
cards.subtitle: Inter-Campus Transit
cards.notes: Board the free shuttle to travel between the Hillside and South campuses. It's the primary way to navigate the 5-mile gap without a car.
cards.short_summary: A complimentary shuttle service connecting the two main campuses and local Metro stations.
cards.evidence_claim: The College also provides a complimentary shuttle service between campuses to help you get to class on time.
cards.access_notes: Requires a valid ArtCenter Student ID to board. Operates until 11:30 p.m. on weekdays.

cards.title: Browse the Student Gallery
cards.subtitle: Hillside Campus Entrance
cards.notes: Visit the gallery at the Hillside entrance to see high-caliber work from current students across all design disciplines.
cards.short_summary: A professional exhibition space showcasing the best student-produced art and design.
cards.evidence_claim: The original Student Gallery, at the entrance to Hillside Campus, for proof of our belief in the power and professionalism of student-produced art.
cards.source_title: Student Gallery - ArtCenter College of Design
cards.access_notes: Open to students during campus hours; typically accessible 12 p.m. to 5 p.m.

cards.title: Lunch at the Hillside Café
cards.subtitle: Main Dining Hall
cards.notes: Grab lunch at the Hillside Café. It's the central social hub for students on the upper campus to refuel between orientation sessions.
cards.short_summary: The primary cafeteria at the Hillside Campus serving breakfast and lunch.
cards.evidence_claim: The cafeteria at Hillside Campus, operated by Sodexo, serves breakfast, lunch and dinner when school is in session.
cards.source_title: What kind of food options are available at ArtCenter and nearby?
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 8:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. during the term.

cards.title: Explore the Fogg Library
cards.subtitle: Hillside Campus Resources
cards.notes: Check out the extensive collection of design books, zines, and video games. It's a quiet place to plan your first semester projects.
cards.short_summary: The main library at the Hillside Campus specializing in art and design resources.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library also features extensive collections of zines and video games; plus subscriptions to dozens of online databases.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 10 a.m. to 7 p.m.; Friday until 5 p.m. Closed weekends.

cards.title: Afternoon at Sinclaire Pavilion
cards.subtitle: Outdoor Student Lounge
cards.notes: Relax at this open-air pavilion. It's designed for students to gather and exchange ideas outside of the formal studio environment.
cards.short_summary: A flexible outdoor programming space and student lounge at the Hillside Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sinclaire Pavilion provides students a place to gather, socialize, study and exchange ideas.
cards.source_title: Facilities - ArtCenter Catalog and Student Handbook
cards.access_notes: Open to all students for leisure and study; formal events require scheduling.

cards.title: Gear Up at the Student Store
cards.subtitle: 1111 Building, South Campus
cards.notes: Pick up your required art supplies and ArtCenter apparel. The South Campus location is convenient for those living in downtown Pasadena.
cards.short_summary: The official campus bookstore for art supplies, textbooks, and university merchandise.
cards.evidence_claim: ArtCenter - South Campus Store. Street Address. 1111 S Arroyo Parkway. Pasadena, California 91105.
cards.source_title: Hours, Email & Contact Information | ArtCenter Student Store
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 9 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.; Friday 10 a.m. to 3 p.m.

cards.title: Meet Up at Kohl Commons
cards.subtitle: South Campus Social Hub
cards.notes: Head to the 1111 Building's ground floor to socialize. This vibrant space is the main dining and gathering hub for the South Campus.
cards.short_summary: A communal dining and social space at the South Campus 1111 Building.
cards.evidence_claim: Kohl Commons is not only a place to nourish the body, but also a social hub that serves as the South Campus epicenter.
cards.source_title: Terri and Jerry Kohl Commons - ArtCenter College of Design
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; dining services typically end at 3:00 p.m.

cards.title: Visit the Williamson Gallery
cards.subtitle: Art and Science Exhibitions
cards.notes: Explore the intersection of art and science. This gallery hosts major exhibitions that are integrated into the college curriculum.
cards.short_summary: A premier exhibition space at the Hillside Campus featuring world-class artists.
cards.evidence_claim: The 4,600-square-foot Alyce de Roulet Williamson Gallery... producing three major exhibitions per year.
cards.source_title: Alyce de Roulet Williamson Gallery | Exhibitions - ArtCenter College of Design
cards.access_notes: Open Wednesday to Saturday, 12 p.m. to 5 p.m. Reservations recommended.

cards.title: Engage at the Leader Showcase
cards.subtitle: Orientation Finale
cards.notes: End your weekend by viewing the work of Orientation Leaders. It's a great chance to ask upperclassmen for advice on thriving at ArtCenter.
cards.short_summary: An event where new students engage with Orientation Leaders and view their creative work.
cards.evidence_claim: The 'Pathways to Success: Leader Showcase' will take place... engage with Orientation Leaders, view their work, and gather advice.
cards.source_title: ArtCenter College of Design to Welcome New Students With Comprehensive Orientation
cards.access_notes: Typically held on the Friday or Saturday of orientation week; check the schedule for locations.
